```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(stringi)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(jsonlite)

feature_cols <- c(
  "popularity", "duration_ms", "explicit", "danceability", "energy", "key",
  "loudness", "mode", "speechiness", "acousticness", "instrumentalness",
  "liveness", "valence", "tempo", "time_signature", "track_genre"
) #contains names of Spotify features

#String manipulation
normalize_text <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") |>
    str_remove_all("\\s*[\\(\\[].*?[\\)\\]]") |>  
    str_remove_all("\\s-\\s.*$") |>               
    str_replace_all("&", "and") |>
    str_remove_all("[^a-z0-9 ]") |>
    str_squish()
}

make_key <- function(track, artist) {
  paste(normalize_text(track), normalize_text(artist), sep = "||")
}

#Import files -- Used help from Claude
read_streaming_history <- function(paths) {
  needed <- c(
    "ts", "ms_played", "master_metadata_track_name",
    "master_metadata_album_artist_name", "master_metadata_album_album_name",
    "spotify_track_uri", "skipped", "shuffle", "platform",
    "reason_start", "reason_end"
  )
  map_dfr(paths, function(p) {
    d <- as_tibble(fromJSON(p, flatten = TRUE))
    d |>
      select(any_of(needed)) |>
      mutate(
        across(everything(), as.character),  # avoid type clashes
        # Video files hold mostly Wrapped stories / video loops
        source = if_else(str_detect(basename(p), "Video"), "video", "audio")
      )
  })
}

#Clean history
clean_history <- function(raw) {
  raw |>
    transmute( #Used Claude
      played_at    = ymd_hms(ts, tz = "UTC"),
      track_name   = master_metadata_track_name,
      artist_name  = master_metadata_album_artist_name,
      album_name   = master_metadata_album_album_name,
      track_id     = str_extract(spotify_track_uri, "(?<=spotify:track:)[A-Za-z0-9]+"),
      ms_played    = as.numeric(ms_played),
      skipped      = as.logical(skipped),
      shuffle      = as.logical(shuffle),
      platform, reason_start, reason_end, source
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(track_name), !is.na(artist_name), !is.na(played_at)) |>
    distinct(played_at, track_name, artist_name, ms_played, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
      platform_clean = case_when( #Used Claude
        str_detect(str_to_lower(platform), "^ios")        ~ "iOS",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(platform), "^android")    ~ "Android",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(platform), "^windows")    ~ "Windows",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(platform), "^(os x|osx|mac)") ~ "macOS",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(platform), "^web_player") ~ "Web player",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(platform), "^partner")    ~ "Partner device",
        TRUE                                              ~ "Other"
      ), 
      minutes_played = ms_played / 60000,
      is_stream = ms_played >= 30000,   
      date    = as_date(played_at),
      year    = year(played_at),
      month   = month(played_at, label = TRUE),
      hour    = hour(played_at),
      weekday = wday(played_at, label = TRUE, week_start = 1),
      match_key = make_key(track_name, artist_name)
    ) |>
    arrange(played_at) |>
    mutate(row_id = row_number(), .before = 1)
}

#Import data from Kaggle
prep_kaggle <- function(path) {
  k <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    select(-any_of(c("...1", "")))

  k_by_id <- k |>
    group_by(track_id) |>
    summarize(
      across(-track_genre, first),
      track_genre = str_c(unique(track_genre), collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(match_key = make_key(track_name, str_split_i(artists, ";", 1)))

  lookup_id <- k_by_id |> select(track_id, all_of(feature_cols))

  lookup_name <- k_by_id |>
    arrange(desc(popularity)) |>
    distinct(match_key, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    select(match_key, all_of(feature_cols))

  list(by_id = lookup_id, by_name = lookup_name)
}

#Merge history
merge_history <- function(history, lookups) {
  by_id <- history |>
    inner_join(lookups$by_id, by = "track_id") |>
    mutate(match_type = "track_id")

  rest <- history |> anti_join(by_id, by = "row_id")

  by_name <- rest |>
    inner_join(lookups$by_name, by = "match_key") |>
    mutate(match_type = "name")

  unmatched <- rest |>
    anti_join(by_name, by = "row_id") |>
    mutate(match_type = "unmatched")

  bind_rows(by_id, by_name, unmatched) |>
    arrange(row_id) |>
    select(-match_key)
}

#Data Analysis
build_listening_dataset <- function(history_paths, kaggle_path, verbose = TRUE) {
  history <- history_paths |> read_streaming_history() |> clean_history()
  lookups <- prep_kaggle(kaggle_path)
  out <- merge_history(history, lookups)

  if (verbose) { #Used Claude
    message("Plays after cleaning: ", nrow(out))
    print(count(out, match_type) |> mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)))
  }
  out
}
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(
  "Spotify Extended Streaming History",
  pattern = "Streaming_History_(Audio|Video).*\\.json$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
) #Used Claude for debugging

length(files)
```

```{r}
df <- build_listening_dataset(files, "dataset.csv")

head(df)

write.csv(df, "listening_data.csv")
```
